{"id":1790997155,"question_id":653,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"9 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1759576236,"status":11,"status_display":"Wrong Answer","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1790997155/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Two Sum IV - Input is a BST","memory":"N/A","code":"/**\n * Definition for a binary tree node.\n * struct TreeNode {\n *     int val;\n *     TreeNode *left;\n *     TreeNode *right;\n *     TreeNode() : val(0), left(nullptr), right(nullptr) {}\n *     TreeNode(int x) : val(x), left(nullptr), right(nullptr) {}\n *     TreeNode(int x, TreeNode *left, TreeNode *right) : val(x), left(left), right(right) {}\n * };\n */\nclass Solution {\npublic:\n    void getinorder(vector<int>&inorder , TreeNode* root)\n    {\n        if(!root) return;\n\n        getinorder(inorder , root->left);\n        inorder.push_back(root->val);\n        getinorder(inorder , root->right);\n    }\n\n    bool findTarget(TreeNode* root, int k) {\n        vector<int>inorder;\n        getinorder(inorder , root);\n\n        int i = 0;\n        int j = inorder.size()-1;\n\n        while(i <= j)\n        {\n            int sum = inorder[i] + inorder[j];\n\n            if(sum == k) return true;\n            else\n            {\n                if(sum < k)\n                    i++;\n                else \n                    j--;\n            }\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"two-sum-iv-input-is-a-bst","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":868}
